# New renderings — iliad-055 (Iliad 9.307–429)

Rows in the house table's format. Each is a formula or word that will plainly recur; the first three extend existing rows. (Pass 2: ἱρὰ ῥέζω was found to be a reuse and is marked so in its row.)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| ἕρκος ὀδόντων (ἀμείψεται ἕρκος ὀδόντων, 9.409) | "the fence of the teeth" | "the fence of his teeth" | "the barrier of the teeth", "wall of the teeth", "the teeth’s enclosure"; ἕρκος is "fence, enclosure" and is kept so (not "wall", which is τεῖχος) |
| κλέος ἄφθιτον (9.413) | "fame unfailing" | "my fame will never fail" | "undying glory", "imperishable fame" (the "undying/imperishable" register is kept off ἄφθιτος, as in the shipped ἄφθιτοι ἄμπελοι "unfailing vines" and the sceptre "unfailing for ever"); κλέος is "fame" here so that κλέος ἐσθλόν "good fame" (9.415), the other half of Achilles’ choice, uses the same word |
| ἐρίβωλος (Τροίην ἐρίβωλον, 9.329; Φθίην ἐρίβωλον, 9.363) | "rich-clodded" | "rich-soiled" | "fertile", "rich-glebed"; extends the Odyssey row Σχερίη ἐρίβωλος ("rich-clodded Scheria" / "rich-soiled Scheria"), with ἐριβῶλαξ staying "rich-soiled" in both layers (1.155) |
| χάρις (οὐκ ἄρα τις χάρις ἦεν μάρνασθαι, 9.316) | "gratitude" | "gratitude" | "favour" (the shipped rendering at 5.211 is for a favour done or sought; here χάρις is the thanks owed for service), "thanks", "reward" — a departure from "favour", recorded for that reason |
| ἱρὰ ῥέζω (ἱρὰ Διὶ ῥέξας, 9.357) | "sacrifices … having performed" | "having performed the sacrifices" | reused, not new: follows the shipped ἱερὰ ῥέξας "performing the sacrifices" (iliad-002, 2.145) and the table’s ἱρά "the sacrifices" (2.420); "sacred offerings", "the offerings", "the rites" (turned down at 2.420), "having sacrificed" (the cognate object is kept instead) |
| εὐπλοίη (εὐπλοίην δώῃ, 9.362) | "a fair voyage" | "a fair voyage" | "good sailing", "favourable winds", "smooth passage"; εὖ + πλόος |
| Ἑλλήσποντος ἰχθυόεις (9.360) | "the fish-teeming Hellespont" | "the fish-teeming Hellespont" | "fishy" (turned down), "rich in fish"; ἰχθυόεις keeps "fish-teeming" as in the Odyssey row for ἰχθυόεντα πόντον; the plain Hellespont stays "the broad Hellespont" (7.86) when πλατύς |

## One-off choices (not recurring; listed for the reviewer)

- ἀφήτορος (Φοίβου Ἀπόλλωνος, 9.404): rendered "archer" in both layers, with a note that the meaning is uncertain (from ἀφίημι "let fly"; another ancient view connects it with prophecy). "Archer" is not otherwise used for ἑκηβόλος (kept "far-shooting"), so there is no clash.
- ἐν καρὸς αἴσῃ (9.378): "at a Carian’s portion" (`l`), "at a Carian’s lot" (`i`), with a note that καρός is of uncertain meaning; αἶσα keeps "portion"/"lot" as in the table.
- κύνεος (9.373): "dog-like" (`l`), "dog that he is" (`i`); not the same word as κυνῶπα "dog-face" (1.159).
- διχθαδίας κῆρας (9.411): "twofold death-spirits" / "two kinds of death-spirit", following the table’s κῆρες θανάτοιο "death-spirits" and not "fates".

## Reused from the packet and the Odyssey table (no new choice)

9.307 and 9.308 (packet), 9.314 and 9.359 (packet; 9.314 ends in an ano teleia here, but the published strings are kept word for word, so its `l`/`i` close with a full stop as the validator requires), 9.312 (Odyssey 14.156, ὁμῶς Ἀΐδαο πύλῃσι), ἠΰκομος, δῖος, κρείων Ἀγαμέμνων, μητίετα Ζεύς, εὐρύοπα Ζεύς, κλυτὸς ἐννοσίγαιος, ἀνδροφόνος Ἕκτωρ, μερόπων ἀνθρώπων, θυμὸς ἀγήνωρ, θυμαλγέα λώβην (reused, “insult”: “heart-paining insult” / “the insult that pains my heart”, as Odyssey 24.326 and the Iliad row at 1.232; “outrage” is kept for the plain noun λώβη), ἀναιδείην ἐπιειμένος, ἀπομηνίσαντος, ἔρρων, γέρας, ἀλαπάζω “lay waste” (ἀλάπαξ’, 9.328; the table keeps “sack” for ἐκπέρθω), ἱρὰ ῥέξας (see the table), ἄκοιτις and ἄλοχος both “wife”, χρυσέη Ἀφροδίτη, γλαυκῶπις Ἀθήνη, ἀργυρόπεζα Θέτις, ἴφια μῆλα, τέκμωρ Ἰλίου, φίλην ἐς πατρίδα γαῖαν, ὑπέρσχῃ χεῖρα.
